name: Place finite odds shifts using a threshold on the verified source-credit direction
motivation: The two-history strength pilot had only .02189 mean absolute probability change on 52 earlier held-history links. Even with perfect reallocation of that amount, its observed paired focal gain on those links was bounded by .00799. Those outcomes were inspected when designing this follow-up. They are exploratory.
split: Use the same two-history pilot and six main cross-fits, disjoint by history for both rule-2 direction and four-path calibration, as in prefix_return.json. Use all 12 calibration windows for one independent deployment model. Do not train on later randomized paths. Record all windows with any published path at numerical freeze separately in each stage.
actor: Within each of initial state, after temporal and after activity, use the pre-action source direction (the unit residual from the early rule-2 fit). Available rules give a log-odds correction of 0 everywhere, -2 everywhere, +2 everywhere, or +2 at or above a training quartile (25th, median or 75th percentile) and -2 below it. Set empirical quartiles separately by position on the calibration windows. Learn the three rule choices jointly by maximizing exact expected two-step question F1, with questions equal within each training history and histories equal. Ties within 1e-12 prefer fewer source thresholds, then fewer nonzero contexts, then lexicographic rule indices (native, constant negative, constant positive, low, middle, high quartile). No KL penalty. Compare the identified actor even if it collapses to a constant per context.
controls: Calibrate the best prefix-only rule with all three contexts able to choose independently among native, -2 and +2. Optimize a shared rule index across all contexts (thresholds use the position's calibration distribution). Also compare to one native-logit offset per context that matches the fitted actor's mean on calibration windows, fixed maximum strength 2 applied to the original verified direction, swapped continuation rules, the earlier strength actor, native, terminal, the earlier mixture, and fixed skills. In the rank output 'prefix' denotes this candidate, 'prefix_shared' the shared-index control, 'prefix_context' the optimized context-only control, 'prefix_rate' the matched-use control, 'prefix_strength' the previous continuous-strength candidate.
decision: Use the same physical assignments, estimators, decomposition, coverage minimum, 0.02 gain over native and terminal, and locked independent evaluations as the strength study. In addition require strictly positive focal gains over optimized prefix-only and the previous strength candidate. The four-history pilot does not authorize independent development.
